description: A sample PHP client script for interacting with TestLink API, demonstrating test case retrieval, project creation, custom field access, and test suite fetching.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class for making XML-RPC calls to the TestLink API server.

methods.name: getTestCasesForTestPlan
methods.description: Retrieves test cases linked to a specific test plan.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project in TestLink.

methods.name: getTestCaseCustomFieldDesignValue
methods.description: Fetches custom field design values for a test case.

methods.name: getTestSuitesForTestPlan
methods.description: Retrieves test suites associated with a test plan.
